title: CISA & FBI IC3: Business Email Compromise (BEC) Financial Kill Chain Procedure
summary: Standard operating procedure for responding to active or suspected vendor wire diversion requests, invoice rerouting, or unauthorized bank account changes.
trigger_criteria: Email requesting changes to recipient bank account numbers, SWIFT codes, IBANs, or payment schedules, especially when combined with Reply-To domain mismatches or secrecy requests.
immediate_actions: 1. FREEZE ALL TRANSFERS: Immediately place a temporary hold on the pending financial transfer in the ERP/Treasury management system.

2. OUT-OF-BAND VOICE VERIFICATION: Call the vendor using an established, pre-existing telephone number from official accounting records. NEVER dial numbers or click links listed in the suspicious email or invoice.
3. DUAL-AUTHORIZATION AUDIT: Require two distinct corporate authorized signers to approve any vendor banking alteration above $5,000.

4. SWIFT RECALL INITIATION: If funds were already released, contact the originating financial institution immediately and instruct them to issue a formal SWIFT Recall Request within the 72-hour international clawback window.
5. FBI IC3 INCIDENT LODGEMENT: File a detailed incident report at https://www.ic3.gov with transaction hashes, receiving bank details, and complete raw email headers.

title: CISA: Credential Harvesting & Session Hijacking Incident Containment
summary: Rapid containment sequence when an employee interacts with a weaponized phishing link, fake Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace portal, or Evilginx reverse proxy.
trigger_criteria: Employee entered credentials into lookalike login page, acknowledged suspicious MFA prompt, or clicked link flagged for SSRF / Punycode domain.
immediate_actions: 1. REVOKE ALL SESSIONS: Use Entra ID / Google Admin to invalidate all active refresh tokens and sign the user out of all sessions globally.
2. RESET PRIMARY PASSWORD: Force an out-of-band password change with a minimum 16-character passphrase.
3. AUDIT INBOX FORWARDING RULES: Check Exchange / Gmail rules for unauthorized inbox forwarding rules (e.g., auto-deleting billing notifications or forwarding to external Gmail addresses).
4. AUDIT OAUTH CONSENT GRANTS: Inspect registered enterprise apps and revoke suspicious third-party OAuth app authorizations.
5. ENFORCE HARDWARE TOKEN: Provision FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware security key to eliminate future session-replay risk.

title: CERT: Forged Relay & Open SMTP Abuse Containment
summary: Remediation protocol when an email exhibits negative latency, reversed timestamps, or forged intermediate Received headers.
trigger_criteria: Relay hop latency delta ΔT < -60 seconds, or hop IP claiming to be an internal mail exchange from an untrusted public ASN.
immediate_actions: 1. PERIMETER FIREWALL DROP: Add the true originating IP address to the external border firewall blocklist (IPTables / Palo Alto / Fortinet).
2. VERIFY INTERNAL RELAY INTEGRITY: Confirm whether the compromised hop corresponds to an internal open relay or misconfigured outbound smarthost.
3. REJECT UNTRUSTED INBOUND: Configure the edge MTA to strictly validate that Received headers match authenticated TCP connecting peers.
